content.short: Kodiak is Berachain's native liquidity hub featuring automated concentrated liquidity management and token factory.
content.description: Kodiak is the definitive, vertically integrated liquidity hub built natively for the Berachain ecosystem. As the only DEX incubated by the "Build-a-Bera" accelerator, the platform brings advanced liquidity management to the network through its "Kodiak Islands"—automated vaults that dynamically optimize concentrated liquidity positions. Deeply integrated with Berachain's unique Proof of Liquidity (PoL) mechanism, Kodiak allows liquidity providers to earn rewards in the form of BGT emissions. The platform serves as a central hub for asset exchange and liquidity bootstrapping on the Berachain network.
content.meta: Kodiak is the native AMM and liquidity hub for Berachain, offering automated concentrated liquidity and PoL-aligned rewards on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
